# Goal 3 selected bounded architecture

Status: SELECTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION, not implementation acceptance. Native Sol 6.1 max coordinator, 31 October 2026. No code starts until this contract and the closed evidence QA are verified on private research-reference main.

## Decision and scope

Build an **additive SQL-first planned-read API** backed by an authoritative native-owned logical ProgramIR. Preserve every legacy `Query`, `query`, `query_json`, `transact(evaluate=...)`, `SnapshotResult.native` and carrier/FP/transaction contract. Their existing native metrics remain actual native metrics.

Version 1 admits **whole-program positive acyclic rules without expression filters** to parameterized DuckDB SQL. Repeated-variable/literal relational equality is supported with exact tagged identity. Every cyclic SCC, every expression filter anywhere in the program, unsupported capability, or unproved admission/budget condition uses the **whole original bounded native program**, with an explicit fallback reason and scope. This selects the roadmap's bounded-native recursion alternative; it does not pretend to implement recursive SQL or SQL-prefix/native-SCC seeding. No arbitrary IDB-seeding API exists today. Proven linear recursive SQL is a future explicit contract increment, not silently added in this one.

This is not a transparent replacement of the legacy API and does not complete negation, aggregates, cancellation/full accounting, recovery, caching, interval queries or Triplex. Existing public 512 retained-history-row/256-commit/32-operation/text/file caps remain; do not bypass them to claim scale. Deployed v1 Site remains unchanged.

## Authoritative owned IR and actual C API v2

Add a pure native compiler/export boundary reusing the existing parser and static safety validation, not a second Python DSL parser. Export owned logical values and structural IDs, not dictionary-local literal IDs, borrowed vectors or connection-local handles. Add the scalar `td_plan_ir_v1(program)` through the actual pinned unstable C API v2; exact host2.0.0/d54cbbe3 remains. Old native functions retain semantics. Bump extension metadata additively to0.4.0 and reproduce/validate the new artifact; no ABI-stabilization promise.

The IR wire is JSON schema `td.program_ir/1`, language `td.typed/0.3`:

- `relations`: objects `{id,name,arity,edb}`, with unique dense structural IDs; relation0 is readonly `triple/3`. Source names remain case-sensitive; names are diagnostics, never SQL identifiers.
- `facts`: objects `{relation,values}` for body-empty, filter-free ground facts. Values are owned wire objects `{t,v}`: `str` exact text, `bool` exact bool, `i64` canonical decimal string, `f64` canonical16-lower-hex bits (finite, +0 normalized). Preserve every literal bit and string byte; no JSON float literals.
- `rules`: objects `{id,variable_count,head,body,filter_count}`. Atoms are `{relation,terms}`; each term is exactly `{var:integer}` or `{const:wire_value}`. Variables are rule-local structural IDs. Preserve source rule order/IDs. All syntax/binding/arity/undefined-predicate validation runs in the native parser first. Filters remain authoritative parser-validated opaque native-only effects in this version; `filter_count>0` anywhere prohibits SQL for the whole program.
- `answer_relation`: structural ID. Return exact owned metadata, never silently truncate a valid graph. Additional explicit wire-size admission may classify a valid program native-only; syntax/semantic errors are errors, not a catch-all unsupported fallback.
- `budget_model`: versioned metadata exposing the existing positive/no-filter operational bound parameters, including native16MiB output cap and exact typed row-output accounting for arities0..8. These are model parameters/upper bounds, not observed native counters.

A strict Python decoder checks exact keys/types, IDs/references/arity/variable binding, bounded sizes and canonical wire values. Malformed native IR must fail before SQL/output; no broad exception-to-SQL fallback. Missing genuine helper/artifact is NativeUnavailable/UNRUN, not a fake parser. Preserve execution-time FP admission; do not introduce state-permission caches or unsafe folding/reuse. The C callback performs no reentrant SQL.

## Additive Python boundary

New module `storage/planner_v1.py` owns `PlannerLimits`, `PlannedQuery`, `PlanExplanation`, `PlannedSnapshotResult` and confined compiler/executor helpers. `PlannedQuery` contains a legacy Query plus explicit planner limits and an optional forced-native comparison mode. Reuse the existing exact prepared six-field Query snapshot before BEGIN; do not reread caller getters in a transaction. Capture planner-limit fields once too, recheck readiness after callbacks, and retain supported continuous FP controls. New types/protocols are exact/versioned; no checked capability survives its admitted call.

Root adds thin `TypedTemporalStore.explain_planned`, `query_planned`, `query_planned_json` delegates only after integration. Old method bodies and the single private native-tail callgraph remain unchanged. No planned evaluated-command extension is claimed; existing evaluated commands remain genuine native.

`PlannedSnapshotResult` has snapshot_position/known_at/valid_at, owned tagged `rows`, plan/execution metadata, and `native` only as the genuine native envelope on a native route; it is None on SQL. Never populate rounds/work/derived_facts with SQL counts, zero placeholders or estimates. Explain separates selected route, static proof bounds, observed input/output counts, materialization and fallback reason/scope. Default diagnostics expose generated SQL/parameter types/counts or redacted fingerprints, not literal values. No hidden measured latency or fake EXPLAIN result.

## Snapshot, data and trust admission

Use the same owned store connection, lock, explicit BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK and actual snapshot position. Resolve known_at=None inside the transaction; require0<=known_at<=snapshot_position. SQL binds exact signed BIGINT cuts and uses `valid_from<=valid_at AND valid_at<valid_to AND tx_from<=known_at AND known_at<tx_to`, with no +/-1 or clock narrowing.

The old native LIST includes **all retained rows**, and native validates row domains/intervals before visibility. SQL pushdown must not erase malformed invisible-row errors. Before selecting SQL, perform bounded vectorized SQL admission over ALL retained rows (schema, exact payload/null slots, finite floats, intervals, text bytes/NUL and input allowance), without constructing Python/native input lists. Any detected invalid data selects the original native path before parsing/execution so its genuine failure/precedence is preserved; unexpected SQL errors roll back and propagate, never trigger automatic retry. Valid invisible wrong-type expression inputs must not invent a filter fault.

Require the prototype's owned main base tables/schema/session discipline. Use explicit `main` table qualification, reject unsupported/shadowed/view/schema/session states rather than accidentally evaluating another relation, and allow no user SQL/table names. No new cross-process/concurrent-writer guarantee. Do not replace or repair FP state. After every fallible DB/decoder step, success requires complete owned output and healthy final controls; continuous supported-control/trusted-callee limitations remain explicit.

## Exact SQL and proof-based admission

Generate numeric internal identifiers for every relation, variable and parameter; quoting case-sensitive DSL names is insufficient. Bind every typed positional value explicitly; no named/session fallback, literal SQL interpolation, external views/functions or arbitrary SQL. Fixed typed carriers use tag plus four payload fields; exactly one payload is selected and three are inactive NULLs. Use binary UTF-8/BLOB identity for strings, fixed physical field types, null-safe inactive comparisons and no cross-tag combination casting. SQL set unions/dedup preserve tagged identity and canonical zero; no ordered/partial expressions in this subset. Output is canonical, finite, eager and owned; new SQL conversion must preserve domain/byte/bit checks without weakening public codec guards.

Analyze SCCs from the whole validated graph, not just the answer cone. SQL admission must cover all program facts/rules and native operational limits, even for answer-unreachable relations. Conservative proofs may cause a native fallback; they must never invent a native error or an observed native metric.

For filter-free acyclic programs, implement clamped integer upper bounds justified against the inspected core:

1. Let E be the visible logical EDB set count after ALL-row validation. Obtain typed literal-pattern counts through vectorized same-snapshot SQL, not materialized native/Python facts. In topological order bound each IDB by its ground-fact count plus rule head bounds. A safe initial head bound is the product of body relation/pattern bounds; projection onto variables all covered by one body atom may tighten to that atom's bound. Constants/dedup only reduce counts.
2. Bound total native facts by E plus all IDB bounds (including unreachable relations). Bound rounds by longest dependency path plus one quiescent round; overestimation is safe. Handle empty inputs/ground facts conservatively.
3. For each nonempty-body rule with m atoms, let C=max(1,the FULL relation bounds of its atoms), NOT a smaller all-literals-matching pattern count. The native chosen single-column index may visit and charge rows later rejected by another literal, so filtered pattern counts are unsafe for this work bound. Each greedy join depth visits at most C^d candidates; each round has at most m delta variants. A safe no-filter work bound is `round_bound * sum_rules(m * sum(d=1..m,C^d))`. Clamp before large arithmetic. Indexing/rejection/dedup reduce this bound; filters are excluded because their charged/eager effects require another proof.
4. Bound native answer bytes using the exact exported typed output-row model and observed/global maximum validated string bytes plus program literals. No sizeof guesses or invented accounting. SQL may run only if all fact/round/work/output bounds fit the requested legacy caps and native output limit. Otherwise explain and run the whole native program.
5. Additional initial planner limits are conservative per-call bounds, not full resource accounting: visible retained rows<=512, output-row bound<=16384, global candidate-binding bound<=65536, total IDB-row bound<=65536; use the native existing arity/rule/body/program caps. Bounds exceeding these select native BEFORE successful SQL output. Never silently LIMIT/truncate. Exact field names can follow the native limits; the decoder/model and proof tests must agree before SQL is enabled.

Compile admitted whole-program relations into parameterized SQL set unions/joins, preserving constants, repeated variables, arities and duplicate rules. Do not rely on short-circuiting for semantics. SQL input snapshot predicates and relational literal/join predicates belong in SQL; eligible execution must not call td_query_v2 or build its LIST input. Native parser-only IR is permitted. Full drain/fetch/validate precedes commit/return; prepare/first row is not success. A new/undrained-result/cancellation/error path must roll back with no partial success and demonstrate store health or explicit restart-required status. No automatic fallback after an unexpected execution/decoder error.

## Required acceptance and honest performance

The73 recovered corpus cases remain UNRUN until genuine integration. Use an independent typed oracle, native baseline and browser reference where supported. Mandatory SQL routes include scan, typed literals/all four tags and subnormal/+0 bits, case-distinct names, duplicate/head unions, repeated variables, selective two-atom EAV joins and safe acyclic IDBs. Assert route and absence of native LIST/td_query_v2 in actual SQL/plan evidence; an always-native implementation cannot pass. Mandatory native fallbacks include all filters (false-then-fault, empty join, pre-dedup and unreachable-rule effects), mutual/nonlinear/linear recursion, and unproved/budget-exceeded plans. Compare actual full rows/cuts and failure/rollback behavior, not marker/checksum alone. Check low native caps/global effects, corrupt visible/invisible data, full-width clocks, callbacks/readiness, NativeUnavailable, late fetch/codec/no-prefix, schema/session rejection, reopen/retry and request/output ownership.

Run all old suites on the final exact candidate, direct-core sanitizers/reproducible builds, actual2.0 loading and old-host rejection; retain existing binding/host sanitizer limitations. Validate native IR independently against authoritative parse/static errors, schema/escaping and all literal identities. Source-owned changes must be frozen before independent execution QA; no mutable-source timing.

Benchmark only after correctness and a frozen protocol. Use real public bounded store fixtures with actual retained/visible counts at small/128/320-or-384/512 strata as feasible; never bypass the512 retained-row cap or confuse wide output with scale. Predeclare workload/selectivity/fanout/depth and supported/fallback routes. Compare planned SQL, forced-native planned route and legacy native separately with the same current artifact; never pool old studies. Preserve all full typed oracle outputs, raw warmups/repeats, strict outer/controller/child exits/timeouts/errors and round/load strata. Separate E0 statement/prior-disposal timing, E1 identically charged owned output/normalization, and E2 fresh-process lifecycle/setup. Charge compilation/admission/snapshot/output equally; report actual EXPLAIN/settings rather than presumed cache/reuse. Profiles are separate. No universal speed SLO/equivalence/production claim. If progress is blocked by a real semantic/performance area, run a targeted new primary research round before modifying that area.
